homeManifesto.title: Beyond syntax: architecture, resilience, and educational mission
homeManifesto.p1: Modern software engineering requires going beyond transient frameworks. My practice is grounded in durable engineering principles: strict separation of concerns, explicit contracts, proactive security by design, and continuous observability.
homeManifesto.p2: In the university lecture hall, I translate complex distributed systems into accessible pedagogical methodologies, mentoring the next generation of engineers. In research, I investigate how AI can elevate computer science education and software reliability.
